stem.en: A sea breeze turns around within a day, but the monsoon wind takes months. Why?

text.en: The Sun does not rise or set over large countries.

feedback.en: The Sun rises and sets over all of India every day.

text.en: Day and night drive the breeze; summer and winter drive the monsoon.

feedback.en: Yes. The same cause works over a longer time.

text.en: Only the monsoon depends on land and sea heating differently.

feedback.en: Both depend on land and sea heating differently.

text.en: The monsoon blows only over the sea, never over land.

feedback.en: The monsoon blows from sea to land in summer and from land to sea in winter.

explanation.en: Both winds come from unequal heating of land and sea. The sea breeze follows the heating of a single day. The monsoon follows the heating and cooling of a whole season across India and the seas around it.

hints.en: Both have the same cause. What differs is how long the heating lasts.
